```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "08b"),
  funs = c("cea_helpers", "report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "scales", "dampack",
               "flexsurv", "survival"),
  set_theme = FALSE,
  quiet_sources = TRUE
)
```

```{r display-table}
display_df <- enriched_comparison %>%
  transmute(
    Biomarker,
    Prevalence = sprintf("%.1f%%", Prevalence * 100),
    Base_Cost = format_eur(Base_Cost),
    Base_Effect = sprintf("%.3f", Base_Effect),
    Base_ICER = format_icer(Base_ICER, Base_Status),
    Base_Frontier = frontier_label(Base_Frontier_Status),
    Enr_Cost = format_eur(Enr_Cost),
    Enr_Effect = sprintf("%.3f", Enr_Effect),
    Enr_Ctrl_Cost = format_eur(Enr_Ctrl_Cost),
    Enr_Ctrl_Effect = sprintf("%.3f", Enr_Ctrl_Effect),
    Enr_Screening = format_eur(Enr_Screening_Cost),
    Enr_ICER = format_icer(Enr_ICER, Enr_Status),
    Pct_Change = ifelse(is.na(Pct_Change), "--", sprintf("%+.1f%%", Pct_Change))
  )

kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table S6: Full enriched-population cost-effectiveness results",
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(display_df) - 1))
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "All ICERs are pairwise comparisons against standard of care. Base case compares each guided strategy with overall standard care; enriched analysis compares biomarker-positive experimental and biomarker-positive control arms.",
      "Enr_Screening is the expected screening cost per identified positive (biomarker test cost divided by the canonical prevalence); it is included in Enr_Cost in place of a single test, while Enr_Ctrl_Cost includes no test.",
      "Base_Frontier is the dampack efficiency-frontier status of the guided strategy among the three base-case strategies. A frontier-dominated strategy (more costly and less effective than the other guided strategy) still has a finite pairwise ICER; the percentage change is shown only for frontier strategies with finite, positive pairwise ICERs in both analyses."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(enriched_comparison, file = here("tables", "table_s6.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table S6 has been saved to `tables/table_s6.csv`.
